Compiler-backed inspection resolved the normal FIFO/ASIC generate branches and reported no diagnostics for the supplied fragment.

Let `C = status_cnt_q`; transition descriptions assume reset is deasserted, `flush_i=0`, and a known occupancy.

| Item | Default-resolution result |
|---|---|
| `DEPTH` | `int unsigned`, value `8` ([L20](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:20)) |
| `ADDR_DEPTH` | `int unsigned`, `$clog2(8) = 3` ([L24](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:24)) |
| `status_cnt_n`, `status_cnt_q` | Declared `logic [ADDR_DEPTH:0]`, hence packed `logic [3:0]`, width 4 ([L50](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:50)) |

1. `status_cnt_q` reads: three continuous assignments—`usage_o` slice ([L63](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:63)), `full_o` comparison ([L69](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:69)), and `empty_o` comparison ([L70](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:70)). The `read_write_comb` process reads it for the default next state ([L79](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:79)), push increment ([L116](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:116)), pop decrement ([L127](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:127)), simultaneous hold ([L131](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:131)), and the syntactically present disabled branch ([L134](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:134), [L142](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:142)).

2. `status_cnt_q` has exactly three writes, all in the sequential block: asynchronous reset to zero ([L158](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:158)); synchronous `flush_i` reset to zero ([L165](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:165)); otherwise `status_cnt_q <= status_cnt_n` ([L171](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:171)). Priority is reset > flush > normal next-state commit.

3. `status_cnt_n` is read only at the normal sequential commit in L171. Its five writes are all blocking, staged next-state assignments: default `C` (L79), `C+1` for accepted push (L116), `C-1` for accepted pop (L127), `C` for accepted simultaneous push/pop (L131), and `C` in the disabled branch (L142). None reads `status_cnt_n` on its RHS: this is not in-place read-modify-write; later assignments simply override the temporary staged value.

4. With defaults, `FifoDepth=8`, `full_o=(C==8)`, and `empty_o=(C==0)` ([L43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:43), [L69–70](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:69)).

| Inputs | Acceptance guard and resulting next state |
|---|---|
| Push only | Accepted when `push_i && ~full_o` ([L99](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:99)); for legal `C=0..7`, `n=C+1`, write pointer advances, and the ASIC memory path stages a write. At `C=8`, it is rejected. |
| Pop only | Accepted when `pop_i && ~empty_o` ([L119](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:119)); for `C=1..8`, `n=C-1` and read pointer advances. At `C=0`, it is rejected. |
| Neither | No operation condition fires, so the default `n=C` and pointers retain their registered values. |

5. Simultaneous `push_i=pop_i=1`:

| Pre-edge `C` | Accepted operations | Final `status_cnt_n` | Assertion consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Push only; pop is blocked by `empty_o` | 1 | `empty_read` requires `~pop_i`, so this input combination violates that source assertion ([L226–228](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:226)). |
| 1..7 | Both accepted | `C`; L131 overrides the earlier `+1` then `-1` staging | Neither full nor empty assertion antecedent is true. Both pointers advance. |
| 8 | Pop only; push is blocked by `full_o` | 7 | `full_write` requires `~push_i`, so this combination violates that source assertion ([L222–224](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:222)). |

The assertions are checks, disabled during reset; they are not the acceptance guards and do not alter the combinational update logic. The separate `DEPTH > 0` assertion is satisfied by default `DEPTH=8` ([L217–220](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:217)).

6. The fall-through/Altera procedural branch is syntactically present at L134–145, so its `status_cnt_q` reads and `status_cnt_n` write belong in the source-level inventory. But its guard is false under defaults: `FALL_THROUGH=0`, `FPGA_EN=0`, and `FPGA_ALTERA=0`. Thus it cannot override the counter or pointers in this configuration.

7. `usage_o` is only 3 bits (`logic [2:0]`) and is assigned `C[2:0]` ([L33](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:33), [L63](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/cva6_counter/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cva6_fifo_v3.sv:63)). At full, `C=4'b1000`, so `usage_o=3'b000`, while `full_o=1` because `full_o` compares the full 4-bit counter with `FifoDepth[3:0]`. The extra counter bit represents occupancy 8; the address-width-sized `usage_o` cannot encode 8 and must be interpreted together with `full_o`.

These are static source/default conclusions; they do not establish behavior for unknown (`X/Z`) state, changed parameters, or an external integration that overrides defaults.
